professionalSummary: Experienced execution system engineer with four years at an electronics manufacturer, building process engineer‑specified changes under the plant software standard.
Proven ability to train line supervisors during running shifts, completing 61 sessions with signed records.
Skilled in pilot line testing, lead approval coordination, and comprehensive change documentation.
experienceHighlights: Built execution system changes for two assembly plants following plant software standards.
Conducted 61 supervisor training sessions on live lines, each documented with supervisor‑signed records.
Ensured every change ran on the pilot line first, with pilot records filed and countersigned by process engineers.
Obtained execution system lead approval for every release, recording checks performed.
Documented impact of each change and hand‑over conditions in change records.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Provided two change records with pilot records, lead approvals, and notes, plus three supervisor‑signed training records as verification trail.
